verdict.rationale: Adyen documents relayed authorisation webhooks that carry "the relevant transaction data, including transaction rules and validation checks" for real-time approve or decline decisions. However, the pack never enumerates the decision-grade fields the story asks for. The network-token webhooks cover wallet token lifecycle events, not wallet context on authorisations. Missing for 10: documented merchant name and MCC fields, enhanced merchant data, wallet and entry-mode details on auth events, partial-approval signals, incremental-auth signals, and a field-level payload reference or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, every authorization event carries decision-grade context — merchant name and MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet and entry-mode details, partial-approval and incremental-auth signals

citations.quote: When we receive a payment authorisation request, we send you a relayed authorisation webhook with the relevant transaction data, including transaction rules and validation checks.
Relayed authorisation allows you to make a real-time decision on whether to approve or decline a transaction.
